answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates Sybil resistance by anchoring digital IDs to unique human traits, acting as the pigment that colors valid participants in a sea of bots. An attacker attempting to scale fake nodes faces a cost equivalent to acquiring physical biometric signatures, which is as rare as a comet in a dense field. Maintaining this ivory tower of trusted identity forces adversaries to bear prohibitive operational expenses, ensuring the decentralized economy remains secure.
